details.answer: The "sensitivity" quantity denotes the expected number of unique outputs a word recognition system assigns to adversarial perturbations. It is formally defined as the average number of distinct predictions generated by the system when subjected to perturbations under an attack type, as captured by the equation $ S_{W,V}^A = \mathbb{E}_{s}\left[\frac{\#_{u}(V \circ W({s_1}^{\prime }), \dots, V \circ W({s_n}^{\prime }))}{n}\right] $. High sensitivity implies greater vulnerability to adversarial attacks, as it allows more degrees of freedom for the adversary to affect the downstream classifier.
